card.name: Words just before 'not recommended' or similar
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'is' after a drug or use phrase, right before 'not recommended' or 'not approved'. Also fires on a few other spots like 'take' in 'take part', 'or' before 'over-the-counter', and the Non-Randomized study design label.

modes.label: 'is' before 'not recommended'
modes.description: The word 'is' after a drug or use phrase, ahead of 'not recommended' or 'not approved'.
modes.example: Methylxanthine use<< is>> not recommended in patients who experience a seizure

modes.label: Trial and over-the-counter wording
modes.description: Words in clinical trial text or just before 'over-the-counter'.
modes.example: conducting many types of clinical trials (research studies in which people volunteer to<< take>> part).

modes.label: Study design label
modes.description: Parts of the 'Allocation: Non-Randomized' field in trial listings.
